verdict.rationale: Flagright documents outbound HTTPS webhooks that push JSON event payloads to your endpoint (e.g., SAR lifecycle events). You can subscribe to multiple events per endpoint, failed deliveries are retried for up to 3 days, and payloads are signed via the X-Flagright-Signature header with secret rolling. missing for 10: evidence that subscriptions can be created or managed programmatically via API (secret rolling is shown in the Console), a complete event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
